caption: The drawing features a single metallic spoon placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The spoon is oriented with its handle pointing upwards and its bowl facing downwards. The bowl of the spoon is oval-shaped, showing subtle gray, white, and blue tonal variations to indicate reflections and its metallic surface. The handle has a slight curve and ends in a decorative, bulbous tip with small, rounded details. The overall depiction uses shades of gray, blue, and hints of white to convey the reflective quality of metal. There are no additional objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Silver Funeral Spoon
